verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware authentication token, and its documented design requires user presence (a physical touch) for cryptographic operations. Background autonomous automations are not a capability axis for this kind of product. The scriptable ykman CLI and SDKs are developer building blocks for integrating the key, not a product feature for setting up automations, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
